searchText: Hi everyone, My updates #1: https://hackmd.io/@9bzKNIy9RfuuOfvcoP5Dxg/EPF_1 Hi Fredrik, <@199253896399421440> I'm interested in the validator performance and chain conflicts analysis ideas. I have a background working in these areas as well. I would like to talk to you about these topics in detail. I sent you a friend request as well. Hi everyone here is my 2nd Dev Update better late than never lol! https://hackmd.io/@Rs7-mZniS1WXLPIkTdk4Mg/SJ1vkU1Ii I've spent the last few weeks working to sift through and understand the ethereum-consensus spec and mev-rs to work towards finishing signature verification for mev-rs. I plan to build out mev-rs as my project for the EPF. Huge thank you to <@539495253418180618> for his patience with my many questions! Shout out for Robert merging his first change to Teku as part of his fellowship 👏 https://github.com/ConsenSys/teku/pull/6384 awesome! I've accepted the friend request so we can speak there if you want 🙂 Thank you for mentorship and code review! 🚀 Dev updates week 3 | 14.11-20.11. Standup call starts in an hour folks! Join us to share your updates https://meet.ethereum.org/epf-standup Starting now! <@&857649635274915900> A new project idea just landed, API endpoint for verifying ETH supply by Tim Beiko. https://github.com/eth-protocol-fellows/cohort-three/blob/master/projects/project-ideas.md#api-for-calculating-eth-supply Recording from today's standup call https://drive.google.com/file/d/1WG5xq7UEtd1DhhUjma1tsjzjRLCrK5Lp/view?usp=sharing This sounds very interesting.
